killGateResolution.why: The CPU-saturation root class is not faithfully reproducible by a per-op cost model. Real calibrated sink cost x frequency = <0.03% of the 120s budget (finding 7); the earlier repro saturated only via ~1725x-inflated placeholder coefficients (finding 6); both re-aims (snapshot-build, CDC row-fetch) refuted (findings 7, 11); 99.94% of the rejoiner's blocking is UNATTRIBUTED synchronous work the model cannot charge (finding 11). Forensics (finding 13): the saturation is the LEADERSHIP-FLAP LIMIT CYCLE re-sync storm, i.e. coordination churn, not per-op CPU cost — 'the cost model was the wrong tool.' The coordination root reproduces without any cost model (findings 1, 10). Census corroborates: PASS/FAIL structurally indistinguishable, no chargeable signature (finding 15).
killGateResolution.decision: PIVOT to Option A (logical circle / bug-finding); cost model NOT required. First Option-A hunt dt-drain-safety-overremoval-hunt already SOLVED. Promising next Option-A target: the leadership-flap limit cycle (a coordination dynamic the DT6 substrate can host + PCT-race).
killGateResolution.sealHonored: The bar was NOT relaxed to aggregate passRate, a single root, or a bare label string; it was left unmet and the sealed refuted branch recorded, per the kill-gate-no-goalpost-move constraint.

note: SEALED kill-gate. metric = number of REQUIRED distinct latency-root CLASSES still UNPROVEN (starts at 2: one CPU-saturation missed-budget root AND one non-CPU coordination tail / leadership-handoff). The oracle probe marks done when metric<=target, so metric counts DOWN to target=0. A root class counts as PROVEN only when the cost-modeled in-process harness reproduces the docker classifier's DISCRIMINATING SIGNAL for that root (NOT the noisy top-line label string), red-on-revert (removing the cost charge / lever flips the signal to converged), AND the in-process directional verdict matches a docker single-run trace on the shared seed/inputs across a >=2-point parameter sweep. DISCRIMINATING SIGNAL, per root: coordination tail = the handoffRequest present (drive the replacement election -> progress) vs null (WAIT_REPLACEMENT_LEADER_OWNERSHIP -> wedge) -- the replacement_leader_pending label STRING is identical in both states, so the string alone is NOT the bar; CPU-saturation = the loadMetrics / in-flight-not-clearing-within-budget chain driven by the simulated event-loop stall -- NOT the bare rootCauseClass:load / nodeSlotUnavailable string (symptom-based, a coordination stall can earn it; nodeSlotUnavailable has zero src refs). The charged-op set MUST be re-profiled at HEAD (parseStepsHistory is memoized away; the live sinks are the priority-recovery snapshot construction + single-record deep-clone + raft uncommitted-suffix scan). The bar is per-run discriminating-SIGNAL agreement, NOT aggregate-passRate correlation (unfalsifiable at p=0.30/N=20). done=true (SOLVED) when metric reaches 0 => cost model viable, the dst-cost-model-circle program proceeds. If an honest cost model cannot prove both classes after genuine attempts, record EXHAUSTED => Option B refuted at the kill-gate (do NOT relax the bar to aggregate passRate, to a single root, or to a bare label string).
